messages:
maria.s: Hey team — need a quick path to get a minimal log extract for vuln triage on a customer's incident. It's potentially PII. What's the approved workflow (RBAC + KMS) and retention window for these kinds of extracts? Also need SIEM event provenance (where in pipeline it came from).

devin_r: Short answer: open a forensic-export ticket, include justification + selector, two approvers (sec + oncall), max TTL 48h, put results in an encrypted bucket with CMK, enable object-level audit. We have a template.

ashley: If there's PII, we need data minimization. Outline fields required and legal will sign off. No exports to personal accounts.

eli_t: Who has ability to unwrap CMK to decrypt? Do we use KMS grants or a proxy unwrap service? My concern is long-lived key grants.

infra-bot: Automated note: Forensic export service requires kms:Decrypt only via kms-grant with expiration. Default grant TTL = 2h. Audit log produced: forensic.export.id.

maria.s: @devin_r can you paste the ticket template? Also how do we capture SIEM provenance (raw ingestion id + enrichments)?

devin_r: Template below. Keep it minimal. Also include 'ingest_id' from SIEM. We write an audit record that maps ingest_id -> exported_objects.

```
Forensic export ticket:
- requester: <name + team>
- incident_id: <INC-XXXX>
- selector: <time range, hostnames, user ids>
- fields_requested: <list>
- justification: <why needed>
- retention_ttl_hours: <=48
- approvers: sec + oncall
- destination_bucket: s3://redwood-forensics-temp
```

devin_r: After approval, ops will run the export via the export-runner which copies objects to the bucket with server-side-encryption using CMK:alias/forensics. The grant is created and bound to the export-runner principal and expires at TTL.

eli_t: OK. Can we limit columns for PII? e.g., redact email and ip hash instead of raw ip.

ashley: Yes — prefer tokenization or hashing. If the customer contract forbids even hashed identifiers, do not include. Legal must approve format.

maria.s: Can the bucket be set to auto-delete objects at TTL? Prefer that over manual cleanup.

devin_r: Yes — lifecycle rule plus a cron job to verify deletion. We also log a 'delete' event to the audit trail.

pager-duty: oncall acked. Quick Q: who can request emergency extension beyond 48h?

devin_r: Security lead + Engineering manager sign-off only, emergency extension needs Jira change request.

maria.s: Thanks — I'll open the ticket with the template and include ingest_id. tagging @ashley @eli_t for approvals. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: forensic.export.queued id=fe-20240302-239

maria.s: Added link to ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/FR-1234

ashley: I'll review the fields today.

eli_t: I'll check the RBAC entitlements for `forensic_reader` and confirm oncall can approve the grant.

maria.s: moving to the channel for record. will update when export is done.
